prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, finish copy/hint/layout, home layout/redesign, sign_in hint/redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) proved helpful and delivered multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on the path selection screen (choose_path, copy) consistently hurt performance.
Adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) showed no clear positive effect and hurt performance.
Notification toggles (home, notification) and waiting screen info (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently higher than the noise-corrected measured results.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Full bleed adoption certificate preview redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a full bleed layout featuring an interactive pet certificate preview with official adoption stamp animation. (why: Adoption screens have proven responsive to redesigns in past tests, and adoption completion time remains high (median 89s, mean 1017s).)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality quiz screen before friend pick: Insert a new interactive quiz screen before friend selection to recommend the best matching pet type based on user preferences. (why: Users take an average of 1017 seconds in adoption and 3 support emails reported difficulty or failure in custom pet selection. A quick quiz streamlines decision-making.)
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet accessories customization screen: Add a new screen after pet friend selection where users pick initial starter accessories for their pet before completing adoption. (why: Redesigning and expanding the adoption flow drives higher user involvement, addressing the drop-off between adoption (76.5%) and final completion.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Stage layout redesign for choose path screen: Redesign the choose path screen into a stage layout with animated path showcases highlighting quick preset versus custom paths. (why: Users take a long mean duration (514s) on path selection. A visually structured stage layout helps users compare paths quickly.)
4: [home, redesign] Full bleed layout redesign for waiting screen: Redesign the loading waiting screen into a full bleed progress dashboard featuring dynamic asset loading animations. (why: The waiting step has a very long mean time (2336s) and 81.3% conversion. A full bleed dashboard engages users during desktop pet compilation.)
5: [sign_in, layout] Compact layout redesign for sign-in screen: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout with streamlined single-click authentication options. (why: Sign-in step conversion is 76.0% with an average time of 567s. A compact layout simplifies sign-in and reduces user fatigue.)
6: [finish, layout] Split layout redesign for home intro screen: Reorganize the final home intro screen into a split layout separating pet welcome visuals from desktop controls. (why: The final step has the lowest conversion rate (64.8%), and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control or open the pet.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop pet visibility hint on home intro screen: Add an explicit status hint on the home intro screen explaining how to locate and summon the pet via the system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet does not show up on desktop or the app fails to launch visually after onboarding.)

scores.note: Adoption redesigns have proven successful (+3.7% across 4 tests) addressing high completion duration.
Adding new screens consistently hurts funnel conversion despite support email complaints.
Inserting extra steps adds friction and historically lowers conversion.
Path selection redesigns show small positive lift (+1.4% across 3 tests).
Home screen redesigns have thin evidence and minimal measured impact (+0.5%).
Sign-in modifications have trended negative or neutral in previous tests.
High drop-off step with support emails, but layout changes at finish previously dropped performance (-1.9%).
Targets the highest drop-off step supported by complaints; hints at finish showed positive lift (+2.8%).
